_about: Shared pronunciation locks for every film. Key = the written word (lower case, whole word only). ph = phonemes in the Kokoro/espeak IPA alphabet (see kokoro_onnx/config.json vocab); stress marks ˈ ˌ go before the vowel. Applied by make_voice.py through pronunciation.py; captions and words.json keep the written word. Add a word here once and it is fixed in all videos.

vespasian.note: espeak gives vɛspˈeɪziən (z + extra vowel); British is ves-PAY-zhun

vespasiennes.note: French vés-pa-ZYEN, final s silent; espeak read it as an English plural (vˈɛspɐsˌiənz). Replaces the old 'say' respelling.
